label: r3c6
name: 2-epoch + lr 1.5e-3 + 32 mb
hypothesis: A stacked bet: r2c2's 2-epoch recipe with both lr 1.5e-3 and 32 minibatches. Each change roughly doubled dev success over the default recipe in round 2. Together they give about four times the effective update size per sample, which should speed convergence within the 184k-step budget. Refuted if it scores clearly below both of its one-change siblings, which would mean updates that are too aggressive destabilise PPO.
